title: Microbiology MVP — review
intro: Task-based walkthrough of the Microbiology / AMR MVP. Sign in as admin / adminADMIN! first. NOTE: the worklist and case pages are real but not yet in the sidenav — use the 'Go to' links below to reach them directly. Mark each step Pass/Fail/N-A and note anything confusing or broken.

steps.do: Sign in (admin / adminADMIN!), then open the Microbiology Worklist directly.
steps.expect: The worklist loads and lists the seeded case(s). (It has no sidenav entry yet — that is a known gap, note it if it blocks you.)

steps.do: From the worklist, open the seeded bacteriology case.
steps.expect: The case workbench opens showing the specimen at stage RECEIVED, with patient/order context and space to record isolates and AST.

steps.do: Review how the specimen, workflow type, and case are keyed together.
steps.expect: The case is tied to a SampleItem × workflow type; the layout reads clearly (inline, not modal-heavy).

steps.do: Record an isolate / organism on the received specimen.
steps.expect: You can add an isolate and advance the case beyond RECEIVED; the state change is reflected in the workbench.

steps.do: Enter an AST result using the seeded reference data (breakpoint standard + antibiotic + panel).
steps.expect: The AST entry surface uses the seeded breakpoints/antibiotics; an S/I/R interpretation is derivable; nothing forces you through a dead end.

steps.do: Find the sibling TB (mycobacteriology) case that shares the same specimen.
steps.expect: One specimen carries both a bacterial and a TB case; opening one does not corrupt or hide the other; the workflow-type routing is clear.

steps.do: Reflect: does this cover enough of a real microbiology bench workflow to be useful, and what's the most important missing piece?
steps.expect: The MVP feels like a coherent starting point; note the single highest-value gap for the next iteration.
